area_note: Central Surabaya (Balai Kota, Jalan Basuki Rahmat, Delta Plaza and Jalan Raya Darmo)
intro: Surabaya's group runs start early in the morning, from about 5am, or after 7pm, to avoid the heat. Central Surabaya is the hub: IndoRunners Surabaya holds its weeknight runs from Delta Plaza, and Kendos Running Crew starts from City Hall (Balai Kota), which is also the start of several of the city's big road races. On Sunday mornings the Car Free Day on Jalan Raya Darmo keeps its main lane clear for walking and running. Clubs announce runs on Instagram, Threads and WhatsApp groups.

clubs.name: IndoRunners Surabaya

meets.where: East car park, Delta Plaza (Plaza Surabaya)

clubs.description: The Surabaya chapter of IndoRunners, running since 2012 and describing itself as the city's biggest running community. Besides the weekly group runs it organises themed runs such as culture runs, sahur runs during Ramadan and New Year runs, and posts updates on Instagram and Threads.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 21 Oct to 6 Nov 2026; Threads posts announcing night runs, 19 and 26 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Kendos Running Crew
clubs.description: A crew founded in April 2014 by six runners outside Surabaya City Hall; the name comes from a Javanese phrase about bursting calves. Runs are easy-paced through the city centre, often followed by coffee, and the crew collaborates with local shops and brands.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts by the crew, 17 Oct to 1 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Galau Running Club
clubs.who: Open to all; friendly fun runs
clubs.description: A Surabaya club whose bio reads "We run together! Join us for friendly fun run". It runs a Strava club with members listed in Surabaya, and acted as race organiser for the PKB Run Festival Jatim in July 2026. Run times are posted on Instagram and Strava rather than in a fixed public schedule.

clubs.name: Suroboyo Mlayu
clubs.description: A Surabaya crew whose name is Javanese for "Surabaya runs". It holds a weekly Saturday-morning run and links a WhatsApp group from its Instagram bio for run details.

clubs.name: GSC Running Club
clubs.description: A Surabaya running club that describes itself as a running and trail association, covering both road and trail running. It does not publish a fixed run schedule on its profile.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts by the club, 30 and 31 Oct 2026

coaches.name: Lari Bareng Kevin (LBK Squad)
coaches.offers: Coaching for runners from beginner to full marathon, starting with a free consultation by Instagram DM; group sessions that include strength training and running drills; a 12-week half-marathon training guide sold for IDR 49,000
coaches.credentials: No coaching certification stated; he also paces races from 5K to the marathon
coaches.description: A Surabaya running coach, Kevin, whose runners train and race together as the LBK Squad. One of his runners posted a sub-4-hour marathon in October 2026.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 28 Jul to 3 Oct 2026; a runner's post tagging the group, 8 Oct 2026; training guide on sale, checked 6 Nov 2026
